Reserve Bank of India Circular

Circular No: RBI/2026-27/89

Date: April 15, 2026

To: All Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) and Commercial Banks

Subject: Master Direction on Liquidity Risk Management

Section 1: Framework

1.1. All covered entities shall maintain a minimum Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) of 100%.

Section 2: Effective Dates

2.1. Provision A shall be effective from June 1, 2026. Provision B for Tier 2 NBFCs shall come into force on October 1, 2026.
